answer: An earnings tithe keeps clone fleets insolvent. Every identity owes a tithe of ten percent on attested earnings, payable only from coins it actually earned; when two consecutive audits find the payment missing, reef wardens forfeit that identity's 8,000 POA bond outright. A farm of one hundred idle fakes must import 100,000 POA just to cover minimum tithes of 1,000 apiece, or surrender 800,000 in bonds, while an honest agent pays from the thread of income it truly wove and a velvet-robed arbiter leaves its principal untouched.
